item.title: Ebola outbreak in DRC surpasses 4,000 cases, reaches displacement camps, officials fear mutation
item.description: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases and 1,800 deaths, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, and has now reached displacement camps in the conflict-affected province of Ituri, according to health officials and UN…

item.title: AI Designs Novel Viruses, Raising Biosecurity Concerns
item.description: Researchers have used artificial intelligence to design new viruses not found in nature, sparking discussions about potential biosecurity risks. The work, conducted at Stanford University, involved training large genome models—analogous to large language models—on DNA sequences. These models, which…

item.title: Demis Hassabis steps aside as CEO of Google DeepMind in major AI shake-up
item.description: Demis Hassabis, the Nobel laureate founder of Google DeepMind, is stepping down as CEO to become chair of the lab and chief scientist of parent company Alphabet, Google announced Wednesday. Koray Kavukcuoglu, DeepMind’s chief technology officer, will replace Hassabis as senior vice president of…

item.title: FDA Approves Replimune Melanoma Therapy Tudriqev After Two Rejections
item.description: The Food and Drug Administration on Aug. 6 granted accelerated approval to Replimune’s engineered viral immunotherapy Tudriqev (vusolimogene oderparepvec-wtpg, formerly RP1) in combination with Bristol Myers Squibb’s Opdivo (nivolumab) for adults with unresectable or metastatic cutaneous melanoma…

item.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Pakistan sign mutual defense pact amid Middle East turmoil
item.description: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan signed a joint defense agreement on Friday, pledging that an armed attack on any one of the three countries would be regarded as an attack against them all.
